RETURN TRANSID ... IMMEDIATE: the task of TRANSID attached at once with the COMMAREA, ahead of any terminal input and any START request, the terminal's next operator step left alone; its EIBAID is not stated by IBM (the crucible runner gives none and a case never reads it), its STARTCODE TD; INVREQ RESP2 1 (no terminal), INVREQ RESP2 2 (below the highest level), LENGERR RESP2 11 return to the program; LINK ... SYNCONRETURN accepted and ignored (IBM: "ignored if the link is local"); IMMEDIATE without TRANSID, and both INVREQs at once (no terminal below level 1), refused
